title: Bloomberg Television v. Zee Entertainment Enterprises Ltd.

content.caseIdentity: Bloomberg Television v. Zee Entertainment Enterprises Ltd., 2024 SCC OnLine SC 426 (Supreme Court of India)
content.citation: 2024 SCC OnLine SC 426 (Supreme Court of India)
content.holding: Reaffirmed the Bonnard v. Perryman principle in India. Pre-trial ex-parte injunctions against media publications must not be granted mechanically; courts must rigorously assess whether the defendant has a plausible defence of truth or fair comment.
content.relevance: Latest Supreme Court authority curbing pre-publication gag orders in corporate defamation suits.
